energyVoucher.title: 2026 Energy Voucher Eligibility & Amount
energyVoucher.subtitle: Pick your benefit type, household traits and household size to see whether you qualify for this year's energy voucher, the yearly amount and how many days are left to apply.

input.title: Your household
input.benefitHint: Select every benefit you receive. If none (near-poverty or general households), you are not eligible.
input.traitHint: It is enough if the recipient or any member on the resident registration applies. With none, you are not eligible.

traitHints.senior: Born on or before Dec 31, 1961 (resident registration)
traitHints.infant: Born on or after Jan 1, 2019, age 7 or under and not yet in school
traitHints.disabled: Registered under the Act on Welfare of Persons with Disabilities
traitHints.pregnant: Pregnant, or less than 6 months after giving birth
traitHints.illness: Has a severe, rare or intractable disease eligible for the health insurance special co-pay rate
traitHints.singleParent: Eligible under the Single-Parent Family Support Act
traitHints.multiChild: A parent with two or more children under 19 (including foster children)

input.sizeHint: Everyone on the resident registration, including family members who are not recipients.
input.winterHint: If you receive any of these, you cannot also get the winter energy voucher.
input.fuelHint: Used to recommend bill deduction or the Kookmin Happiness Card.
input.facility: All members live in a welfare facility and receive benefits there
input.facilityHint: Households whose members all receive benefits in a facility under the National Basic Living Security Act are excluded.

reason.noTrait: Even recipients need at least one member who is a senior, infant, person with a disability or another listed trait.
reason.facility: Households whose members all receive benefits in a welfare facility are excluded.

period.title: When to use it
period.summerOnly: The summer portion is deducted from electricity bills until {date}; anything left after that expires.
period.free: This year the amount is not split into summer and winter portions. Use the total freely during the period; to save it all for winter, ask to skip the summer bill deduction.

apply.title: How to apply
apply.closed: This year's applications are closed. The next program is usually announced in May or June.
apply.late: As long as you apply within the period, you get the full amount even if you apply late.
apply.pause: Applications pause for 2–3 days in late December for processing, so apply early.
whereItems: Visit the community center (eup·myeon·dong) of your registered address (yourself, or a household member or relative with a power of attorney)
If you cannot get around, an official can apply on your behalf with your consent
bringItems: Energy voucher application form (filled in at the center)
For bill deduction: your latest electricity, city gas or district heating bill (apartment management fee bill if you live in an apartment)
For a proxy: the recipient's power of attorney and the proxy's ID
apply.auto: If you received it last year and nothing changed, you are enrolled automatically. If you moved or your household size changed, apply again.

method.title: How to use it
method.summerOnly: The summer portion is deducted from your electricity bill automatically. Winter heating comes from the support you chose.

virtual.name: Bill deduction (virtual card)
virtual.desc: Deducted from your bill automatically. No card needed.
items: Summer: electricity bill
Winter: one of city gas, electricity or district heating
Starts from the next month's bill after you apply with a recent bill
Covers bills issued by May 31, 2027

card.name: Kookmin Happiness Card (physical card)
card.desc: Pay directly with the card. The only way to buy kerosene, LPG or briquettes.
items: Winter only (from Oct 3)
Electricity, city gas, kerosene, LPG and briquettes
Buy kerosene, LPG and briquettes at partner stores (delivery fee included)
Issued by BC, Lotte, Samsung, KB Kookmin, Shinhan and Hyundai Card

why.electric: With electric heating, bill deduction is easiest: it comes off your electricity bill in summer and winter.
why.gas: With city gas, bill deduction is easiest: it comes off your winter gas bill and no card is needed.
why.district: District heating is supported through bill deduction; it is not on the Happiness Card's list.
why.kerosene: Kerosene must be bought with the Happiness Card at a partner store. Delivery fees can be paid by card too.
why.lpg: LPG must be bought with the Happiness Card at a partner store. Delivery fees can be paid by card too.
why.coal: Briquettes must be bought with the Happiness Card at a partner store. If you get a briquette coupon, choose it under other winter heating support.

eligibility.title: Who qualifies
items: Income: recipients of the livelihood, medical, housing or education benefit under the National Basic Living Security Act. Near-poverty and general households do not qualify.

Household traits: the recipient or a member on the resident registration is a senior (born on or before Dec 31, 1961), an infant (born on or after Jan 1, 2019, age 7 or under, not yet in school), a person with a disability, pregnant or postpartum, a person with a severe, rare or intractable disease, a single-parent family, a child-headed household or a multi-child household.
Both criteria must be met, and only a basic livelihood recipient in the household can be the beneficiary.

Households whose members all receive benefits in a facility are excluded. If you receive emergency winter fuel aid, a briquette coupon or the briquette-switch voucher, you cannot also get the winter energy voucher.

amount.title: How the amount is set
items: Only by household size: ₩295,200 for 1 person, ₩407,500 for 2, ₩532,700 for 3 and ₩701,300 for 4 or more (2026 yearly totals).
Household size counts everyone on the resident registration. One voucher per household, however many members qualify.
Households receiving other winter support get only the summer portion (₩40,700–₩102,000), usable on electricity bills until Sep 30.
If your registered household grows, you can request the change by May 31, 2027 to get the amount for the new size.
The voucher is not counted as income for basic livelihood benefits.

use.title: Using it and checking the balance
items: Summer (Jul 1–Sep 30) is electricity bill deduction only. In winter (Oct 1, 2026–May 31, 2027) choose either bill deduction or the Happiness Card.
Bill deduction covers bills issued by May 31, 2027, and card payments must be completed by May 31.

Check the balance on Bokjiro under Welfare Wallet > My Welfare Wallet after logging in, or ask the energy supplier (bill deduction), the card company (card) or the help line (1600-3190). Balances can be checked only during the usage period.
If you move while using bill deduction, the voucher stops automatically. Re-apply at the community center of your new address with a recent bill.

other.title: Other heating support
items: Emergency winter fuel aid (Oct 2026–Mar 2027): fuel money for households in crisis under the Emergency Welfare Support Act. It cannot be combined with the winter energy voucher.
Briquette coupon (KOMIR): coupons for households heating with briquettes. With it, you get only the summer energy voucher.
Briquette-switch energy voucher (new in 2026): replaces a briquette boiler and supports the new fuel (Korea Energy Foundation 1877-5488). It cannot be combined with the winter energy voucher.
Advance exception payment (new in 2026): cash for recipients whose energy costs are included in rent and who cannot pay with the voucher. Ask your community center whether it applies.

items.q: I got it last year. Do I need to apply again?
items.a: If nothing changed during last year's period and you still qualify, you are enrolled automatically. If you moved or your household size changed, you must apply again. You can check your status at your community center or the Energy Voucher Center (1600-3190).

items.q: Do I get the full amount if I apply in November or December?
items.a: Yes. If you apply between Jun 15 and Dec 31, 2026, you get the full amount to use until May 31, 2027. Applications pause for 2–3 days in late December, so apply early. You cannot get support after the period ends. Households receiving other winter support get only the summer portion, so applying after Sep 30 gives them nothing.
By the number of people on the resident registration. The 2026 yearly totals are ₩295,200 for 1 person, ₩407,500 for 2, ₩532,700 for 3 and ₩701,300 for 4 or more. It is not a monthly amount.

items.q: If a senior and a person with a disability live together, do we get double?
items.a: No. The voucher is issued per registered household, so you get one voucher however many members qualify.

items.q: Where can I check my balance?
items.a: Log in to Bokjiro and open Welfare Wallet > My Welfare Wallet. You can also ask the energy supplier (bill deduction), the card company (Happiness Card), the help line (1600-3190) or your community center. Balances can be checked only during the usage period.

items.q: What happens to an unused balance?
items.a: The 2026 voucher must be used by May 31, 2027. Bill deduction covers bills issued by then and card payments made by then; after that the remaining amount cannot be used. For summer-only households it expires after Sep 30.

If you use bill deduction, the voucher stops automatically after 18:05 the day after you register your move. Re-apply at the community center of your new address with a bill to keep using it. If you moved on or after Oct 1, 2026 and use the Happiness Card, you do not need to re-apply, but updating your address is recommended for next year's automatic enrollment.

items.q: Bill deduction or the Happiness Card?
items.a: For city gas, electricity or district heating, bill deduction is easiest because it comes off your bill automatically; district heating is supported through bill deduction. Kerosene, LPG and briquettes must be bought with the Happiness Card at partner stores. In summer both options use electricity bill deduction.

items.q: I get a briquette coupon. Can I also get the energy voucher?
items.a: If you apply during the summer period (Jul 1–Sep 30), you can get the summer portion (₩40,700 for 1 person to ₩102,000 for 4 or more), but you cannot get both in winter. The same applies to emergency winter fuel aid and the briquette-switch voucher.

items.q: Does the voucher reduce my basic livelihood benefits?
items.a: No. The energy voucher is not counted as income when benefits are calculated.
